experiment.name: block_scoped_receive_result
experiment.hypothesis: Give the mode-1 fn_8020D318 return a distinct block-scoped scalar whose lifetime cannot span the later memcpy loop, aiming to assign that disconnected result web to retail r27 instead of generated r28.
experiment.patch: Within if (state->mode == 1), replace `amount = fn_8020D318(...)` with `int result = fn_8020D318(...)` and replace `if (amount)` with `if (result)`; leave the later copy-length scalar amount unchanged.
experiment.result: The distinct block-scoped lifetime did not perturb generated bytes; it reproduced the baseline exactly and was reverted.
